target_audience_draft.selection_basis: General audio-processing and listening utility with account management; no child-directed characters, games, lessons or marketing found in the current native/store sources
target_audience_draft.restriction_note: No mandatory age-restricted gambling, dating or other adult-only functionality was found. Selecting an adult target does not by itself require restricting all minor access.

ads_and_permissions_evidence.source_only_note: Reconcile against the exact uploaded AAB merged manifest/dependencies. Source declares mediaPlayback FGS and notifications; no GPS, microphone, camera, broad file, APK-install or full-screen-intent permission.

some_data_deletion_without_account_delet.mechanism: In-app deletion of eligible completed/failed/cancelled jobs removes owned history/private media through cleanup while retaining the account
some_data_deletion_without_account_delet.shared_media_limitation: Accepted public-link shared objects can remain after job/account deletion; owned records and access are removed
some_data_deletion_without_account_delet.console_answer_note: Use the in-app mechanism if the optional question permits it. Do not invent a separate URL or assert a data-only external request flow has been tested.

content_rating.classification_basis: Music/audio processing and playback utility; not a game, social network, dating app or messaging service
content_rating.questionnaire_email_status: Root uses the owner-provided public contact in Console; do not duplicate private values here

developer_supplied_content.scope: Current supplied UI/copy/artwork only. User-selected audio and imported online material are not certified free of rating-relevant content.

interactive_features.external_share_note: Android ACTION_SEND sends a private audio URI to the system chooser and a separately selected secondary app. Official Google Play rating-question guidance excludes sharing accomplished using secondary apps when evaluating native user interaction; MusicMute has no native user-to-user recipient/chat/feed/exchange service.
interactive_features.native_user_interaction_question: Does the app natively allow users to interact or exchange content with other users through voice communication, text, or sharing images or audio?

online_content.source_supported_scope: User-selected URL import capability, not an app-featured or promoted content catalog
online_content.initial_native_default: file-only until policy permits URL controls
online_content.question: Does the app feature or promote content not included in the initial download that can be accessed from the app?
online_content.question_wording_status: Scope paraphrase of the live Console wording reported by root; not a verbatim transcription
online_content.note: Google's specific IARC Online Content guide excludes content users import themselves and lists a podcast player with no supplied content as having no Online Content. MusicMute processes privately selected files or user-submitted URLs and displays account-owned jobs/results; no curated, featured or promoted media catalog was found. SupportedAudioSites contains provider names and URL rules, not promoted songs or podcasts. The source still supports policy-gated URL acquisition and downloaded playback; the No answer follows the imported-content exclusion, not an assertion that URL capability is absent. This supersedes the earlier broader Yes recommendation and does not certify arbitrary imported audio as rated or moderated.

content_rating.ugc_distinction: Data Safety Other user-generated content includes selected URLs/recovery text. That does not make private processing a public UGC/social service. A reusable shared processing cache is not a browsable user-upload feed.
content_rating.ai_facts: Machine-learning source separation extracts vocals from supplied audio; no chatbot, prompt-to-image generator, voice impersonation or synthetic-person recording feature was found.
content_rating.calculated_ratings_status: Not calculated or verified by this audit; do not pre-claim Everyone, PEGI 3 or any territory certificate

foreground_service.functionality: Users choose original or processed audio in their private Library and start playback. Playback continues while the app is in the background or the screen is locked, with media notification/session controls.
foreground_service.deferred_impact: Requested audio would not begin when the user presses Play.
foreground_service.interrupted_impact: Playback would stop while listening or when the app leaves the foreground; the user would need to return and resume.
foreground_service.demo_video_status: A genuine recording of the current Android release and a reachable reviewer video URL are required; no recording or device proof was created by this audit

android_auto.note: Manifest exposes a MediaLibraryService and car application metadata. Source presence does not prove Android Auto quality/accessibility requirements or car screenshots.

standard_service_provider_basis.Firebase Auth and Messaging: Public standard terms support covered customer-instructed processing
standard_service_provider_basis.Cloudflare R2 customer content: Public self-serve terms/DPA support covered customer-content processing

sharing_assessment.sentry: Exception unresolved: standard terms restrict Service Data to providing/maintaining/improving the service for the customer; Additional Uses are allowed for non-identifying data and customer-authorized other Service Data. The DPA is separately accepted. SDK scrubbing does not prove organization settings, accepted DPA, complete anonymization or all receiver-side purposes.

conservative_editable_draft.note: Provisional disclosure of confirmed third-party diagnostic transfer while exception evidence is missing; not a claim that Sentry actually uses identifiable end-user data independently. Review before any app review submission.

sharing_assessment.other_transfers: Assess first-party hosting/worker/database roles and active URL acquisition recipients. User-directed audio export has a clear sharing action/chooser and can use the user-initiated transfer exception. Do not declare overall No sharing solely from vendor names.

precise_location_conservative_draft.note: A broader editable draft disclosure can include the retained coordinate estimate while its exact classification is unresolved. This is not proof the estimate locates a user inside an area below 3 square kilometers.
